results.title: Nilesh Wadkar murder case: SC grants bail to MCOCA accused after over 7 years in custody
results.description: The Supreme Court granted bail to Abhijeet Ganesh Kadu after over seven years in custody. He was accused in the 2019 murder of Pune gangster Nilesh Wadkar. Co-accused with similar roles had already secured their release from jail. The court considered the prolonged incarceration and parity with other defendants. Kadu must cooperate with the ongoing trial proceedings as directed.
